content: Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years. Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset.

WITH driver_races AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        r.round,
        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id
    FROM f1.main.results res
    JOIN f1.main.races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
),
driver_gaps AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        driver_id,
        round AS next_round,
        constructor_id AS next_constructor_id,
        LAG(round) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY round) AS prev_round,
        LAG(constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY round) AS prev_constructor_id
    FROM driver_races
)
SELECT * FROM driver_gaps 
WHERE prev_round IS NOT NULL 
  AND next_round - prev_round > 1
  AND prev_constructor_id != next_constructor_id

WITH year_races AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) as total_races
    FROM f1.main.races
    GROUP BY year
),
driver_races AS (

        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id
    FROM f1.main.results res
    JOIN f1.main.races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
),
driver_year_counts AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(*) as driver_races_count
    FROM driver_races
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
driver_gaps AS (
    SELECT
        dr.year,
        dr.driver_id,
        dr.round AS next_round,
        dr.constructor_id AS next_constructor_id,
        LAG(dr.round) OVER (PARTITION BY dr.year, dr.driver_id ORDER BY dr.round) AS prev_round,
        LAG(dr.constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY dr.year, dr.driver_id ORDER BY dr.round) AS prev_constructor_id
    FROM driver_races dr
)

FROM driver_gaps dg
JOIN year_races yr ON dg.year = yr.year
JOIN driver_year_counts dyc ON dg.year = dyc.year AND dg.driver_id = dyc.driver_id

  AND dg.next_round - dg.prev_round > 1
